verdict.line: You lose the lane to Yorick's Q sustain and his E-W kill combo before level 6, but win the game once your Q stacks and Trinity Force core come online.

brief.thesis: Yorick's measured lane and solo-kill advantage comes from Last Rites' self-heal and the threat of chaining Mourning Mist into Dark Procession to wall you in for a kill, both of which peak before level 6. Nasus has no comparable early trade tool — Siphoning Strike starts on an 8-second cooldown and only grows strong through CS — so the matchup is won by farming through the early disadvantage rather than contesting it, which is exactly why the overall win rate sits at an even-to-slightly-favored 52% over 1384 games despite Yorick holding the lane.

theirWindow.when: after Mourning Mist's mark lands on you
theirWindow.what: He will immediately follow with W (Dark Procession) to drop a wall and cut off your retreat, then free-hit the marked target. Disengage the instant the mark lands instead of trading through it.

yourWindow.when: once his Q and E are both on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Step in with W (Wither) applied first — without Last Rites' heal or Mourning Mist's slow available, he has no way to out-sustain or escape your decelerate, so this is your highest-value trade window.

start.why: The sustain and poke reduction directly counters Yorick's early Last Rites trades and ghoul chip damage, letting you stay in CS range instead of being zoned off the wave.

boots.why: Lower cooldowns on Siphoning Strike, Wither, and Spirit Fire mean more Q resets for stacking and more frequent Wither punishes on his engages.

core.why: The highest win-rate core path (56.3% over 224 games) — the damage spike is what finally lets you win skirmishes you lost pre-6.
Armor and attack speed slow blunt his auto-attack-reliant Last Rites trading and ghoul swarms in skirmishes.
Stacks with Soul Eater's lifesteal to turn your scaled Q damage into real sustain in extended fights.

situational.when: yorick builds into sustained auto-attack trading and his Last Rites healing starts snowballing fights
his early ghoul swarms and all-ins threaten to kill you before level 6
you need faster wave clear and an extra slow for skirmishes alongside Wither

runes.keystoneWhy: The on-hit sustain offsets Yorick's own Last Rites healing during early trades, letting you farm safely under pressure instead of losing the health race outright.

summoners.why: Flash is your out from the E-W wall-and-kill combo before you have Wither up reliably; Teleport lets you reset waves and keep stacking Q uncontested once you start pulling ahead post-laning. Flash+Ghost posts the highest measured win rate (55.3%) if you'd rather prioritize chasing and escaping over side-lane resets.

playing.title: Prioritize Q stacks over trades
playing.detail: Siphoning Strike only grows stronger when it kills minions or champions, so last-hit everything you safely can rather than contesting Last Rites-sustained trades you lose early.

playing.title: Play around the E-W combo
playing.detail: The moment Mourning Mist's mark lands, back off — Dark Procession's wall right after it is how Yorick springs solo kills on marked targets.

playing.title: Save Wither for his engages
playing.detail: W's movement and attack-speed decay is your best answer to any ghoul-assisted all-in; hold it until he commits rather than using it to poke.

playing.title: Zone waves with Spirit Fire
playing.detail: Drop E on contested CS to shred his armor and make any trade on that ground favor you, since the armor reduction hits everyone standing in it.

playing.title: All-in once R is live
playing.detail: Fury of the Sands' health drain and attack range increase flip short fights in your favor starting at level 6, especially with banked Q stacks.

playing.title: Split-push with Teleport post-laning
playing.detail: Since the data shows you pulling ahead from level 9 onward, use Teleport to reset and keep farming uncontested rather than forcing early teamfights.

brief.patchCaveat: The build, runes, and the 52% Nasus-vs-Yorick win rate over 1384 games are measured from live OP.GG data on the current patch; the lane-phase-versus-scaling read and trade timing are my own tactical analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Focus on farming with [Q] to gain stacks. It is vital that you do not get caught inside Yorick’s (E)-(W) combo when engaging him.
